part.text:
All 1315 gson module tests pass. The fix in `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java`:

- `registerTypeAdapter` (GsonBuilder.java:690) now throws `IllegalArgumentException("Cannot override built-in adapter for " + type)` when the type is `Object.class` or a class assignable from `JsonElement`.
- `registerTypeHierarchyAdapter` (GsonBuilder.java:728) throws the same when the base type is `JsonElement` or a subclass (registering for `Object` remains allowed, per the tests).
- Javadoc for both methods now documents the restriction and mentions `@JsonAdapter` as an alternative.

Verified with `mvn -pl gson test`: `GsonBuilderTest` (12 tests) and the full module suite (1315 tests) pass.
